desc: Decide final algorithm: O(W^2) transfer-matrix composition proven impossible (dense matrices, genuine O(W^3)); fall back to cone-repair approach.
Parse input fast (sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()) — implemented in current solution.
Simulate the full walk from (sh,sw) to record per-time updated cells — implemented.
Implement base DP S[h][w] = A[h][w]*(S[h-1][w]+S[h][w-1]) with F[0][1]=1 boundary trick — implemented.
Implement cone-repair per query (recompute down-right cone of updated cell) — implemented as correctness baseline.
Verify base DP correctness on sample 1 by hand-trace (456/666/822 match) — confirmed by worker.
Attempt suffix-box restriction (cone ∩ future cones): proven insufficient — row-prefix dependencies force full union-cone repair; adversarial (1,1)-hugging walks still O(HW) per query.

Lazy-frontier analysis: naive lazy deferral impossible (answer needed every query and (H,W) always in dirty cone), BUT frontier decomposition with static suffix-G during corner-confined phases is sound: answer = Σ frontier edges F(inside)·G(outside), each path crosses exactly one frontier edge; per-query cost O(k² + k).

Implement frontier + static-suffix-G scheme for corner-confined phases (k ≈ 60–100, hysteresis re-boxing on walk exit, rebuild G in O(HW) per re-box); verify frontier formula on sample 1 by hand; keep block cone-repair for non-confined phases.
Validate the refined solution on both samples (hand-trace sample 1 fully; sanity-check sample 2 logic; run when interpreter available).
If bound still unproven for thin grids, special-case min(H,W) ≤ 2 with closed-form prefix-product + BIT (O(log W) per update).

Micro-optimize: local variable binding, minimal % operations, flattened arrays if needed; remove unused sr/sc computation if it stays unused; consider transposing so inner repair loop runs over the smaller dimension.
